subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: Should this issue remain the combined OpenRouter auto transparency contract, or should its remaining acceptance criteria be assigned to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51441 for resolved-model state and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9016 for exact cost exposure?
rationale: Source establishes the technical gap, but maintainers must choose the permanent issue and API ownership and whether exact cost and resolved identity ship as one cross-surface contract.

options.title: Split canonical ownership
options.body: Track requested-versus-resolved identity in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51441 and provider-cost exposure in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9016 while preserving this issue’s footer acceptance criteria in those scopes.

options.title: Keep combined here
options.body: Retain this issue as the end-to-end OpenRouter auto contract covering transport capture, session and agent state, aggregation, and footer presentation.

recommendation.title: Split canonical ownership
recommendation.body: Track requested-versus-resolved identity in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51441 and provider-cost exposure in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9016 while preserving this issue’s footer acceptance criteria in those scopes.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history most directly connects this person to both the OpenAI-compatible transport seam and the current response-usage surface where the shared metadata contract must land.
